messages.subject: Burrowing and Shade
parts:
Hello,

Just a quick question regarding burrowing and shade.

Within NicheMapR, if an organism is underground (DEP <0.00), does the model also consider it to be in shade? By definition being underground is also being in shade but I wondered if the model also operates like this to this logic.

Many thanks,
Simon

messages.author: e46cb5dd353b7dfb
messages.subject: Re: Burrowing and Shade
parts:
Hi Simon,

No, as in it should not be reported as being in the shade in the output, but yes as in it is not exposed to solar radiation. Also, there's an option to have the animal choose a burrow that is in the sun or the shade.

Hope that helps.

All the best,
Mike
